{{Quote|The jungle barbarians have not been around for more than three hundred years. Their language was long ago absorbed by the mountain Mooloolian tribes&mdash;|C-3PO|<ref name="Vector">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mooloolians''' were a tribe that was native to [[Janguine]],<ref name="Vector" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Halthor sector/Legends|Halthor sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> They occupied the mountainous region of the planet, while a [[Unidentified Janguine species|species]] of barbarians inhabited the jungle regions.<ref name="Vector" /> The jungle barbarians eventually vanished, with the Mooloolian tribe absorbing their [[Janguine (language)|language]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[275 BBY]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|329|Mooloolian}}</ref> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] speculated that the [[Yuuzhan Vong (language)|language]] used by a newly encountered [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], was related to the Janguine language.<ref name="Vector" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[R. A. Salvatore]] created the Mooloolians for his novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'', published by [[Del Rey]] in [[1999]]. They were also mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]].
